operator_conventions.Ozuch_P: 1/2*nabla^*nabla - R^circ (linearization of Ric-Lambda g plus Bianchi gauge)
operator_conventions.important_factor_warning: A claimed P(h_rel)=-4Lambda h_rel is not the Ozuch or Kroencke convention used in the cited sources; with Ric=Lambda g it is P=-Lambda and Delta_E=-2Lambda.

quotient_action.rho: (z,w)->(-z,-w), a pi-rotation in each CP^1 coordinate, with four fixed nodes (0/∞,0/∞)

full_P_kernel_scalar_sector.meaning: kernel of the gauged operator on all symmetric 2-tensors; these are scalar/conformal/gauge/automorphism-type directions, not TT Einstein deformations

TT_kernel.direct_l1_check: for f on one factor, Hess f=-Lambda f g_factor; trace-free gives A+B=0 and divergence-free gives A=0, so the scalar l=1 kernel contributes no TT tensor
TT_kernel.quotient_argument: any quotient TT kernel lifts to a rho-invariant TT kernel on the cover; cover TT kernel is zero

consequence_for_obstruction_program: The TT infinitesimal Einstein deformation space is zero, so there is no small TT kernel amplification.  However the full gauged P-kernel has a 4-dimensional scalar sector on the orbifold quotient; a faithful Ozuch implementation must either quotient/fix these automorphism-normalization directions or include the corresponding v_l variables/projections.  Bubble parameters are not literally the only variables until this gauge issue is fixed.
